description: CREATE a Text DAT in TouchDesigner whose `file` parameter points at a vault note, so the note's text loads into TD (and, with sync:true, stays live as you edit it in Obsidian) — turning the vault into the text/lyrics source for your visuals. Side effect is node creation in TD plus reading the note file; it does not write to the vault. Wire the DAT into a Text TOP to render it. Returns the DAT path, the resolved note, the absolute file path, and whether sync is on. Requires a configured TDMCP_VAULT_PATH, TDMCP_RAW_PYTHON=on, and TDMCP_BRIDGE_ALLOW_EXEC=1.

name.description: Name for the Text DAT (defaults to a slug of the note).

note.description: Vault-relative note to read into TD (lyrics, poetry, any text content).

parent_path.description: Parent COMP to create the Text DAT inside.

sync.description: Keep the DAT synced to the file, so edits in Obsidian show up live in TD.

name: bind_vault_text
title: Bind a Text DAT to a vault note
